meta.source: US EIA-930 Hourly Electric Grid Monitor (EIA930_BALANCE six-month files)
meta.timeConvention: Timestamp is end-of-hour, converted from UTC to US Central
meta.units: MW (megawatts per hour, matching OpenSciEd handout units)
meta.missingDataPolicy: Blank EIA-930 adjusted values treated as 0 MW (EIA reports blanks when a fuel source is offline/not reporting)
meta.notes: 'other' = All Petroleum Products + Other Fuel Sources + Unknown Fuel Sources (EIA adjusted MW). Hydro includes pumped storage. Natural gas excludes petroleum. Column mapping: coal=NG COL, naturalGas=NG NG, nuclear=NG NUC, solar=NG SUN, hydro=NG WAT(+PS), wind=NG WND.

originalColumns.petroleum->other: Net Generation (MW) from All Petroleum Products (Adjusted)
originalColumns.hydro: Net Generation (MW) from Hydropower and Pumped Storage (Adjusted)
originalColumns.otherFuel->other: Net Generation (MW) from Other Fuel Sources (Adjusted)
originalColumns.unknown->other: Net Generation (MW) from Unknown Fuel Sources (Adjusted)
